Replace numpy.array(values, copy=False, ...) with numpy.asarray(values, ...), keeping the dtype and other needed options. If the program truly requires zero copying, keep that requirement and provide a compatible array buffer instead. Do not change the expected values. steps.explanation: Pydantic V2 requires an Optional field when its declaration has no default. The actual missing field is nullable without a default and the supplied input has no unknown field names. This environment has pydantic 2.11.9. Locate the missing Optional field in the model declaration, and add = None if omitting that field is intended (for example email: Optional[str] = None). Keep other required fields and validation intact. Optional controls whether None is allowed; the explicit default controls omission.
